sloka: तवापि मे प्रियं कार्यं त्वत्प्रभावाच्च मे जितम् ।अवश्यं तु क्षमं वाच्यो मया त्वं राक्षसेश्वर ।। ६.११४.९८ ।।
transliteration: tavāpi me priyaṁ kāryaṁ tvatprabhāvācca me jitam ।avaśyaṁ tu kṣamaṁ vācyo mayā tvaṁ rākṣaseśvara ।। 6.114.98 ।।

translations.english: On hearing Vibheeshana's words, Rama, who is good at expression, very affectionately, upholding virtues, spoke as follows to Vibheeshana.
